label: The installation step by step: open the disk image and click Done, click Open Anyway, drag the app into Applications, open it and allow it the same way, open System Settings and turn on Full Disk Access

pictures.caption: 1 · Open the disk image, click “Done”
pictures.line: macOS has not checked it, because the app is not sold through Apple.

pictures.caption: 1 · Click “Open Anyway”
pictures.line: System Settings › Privacy & Security, then open the disk image again.

pictures.caption: 2 · Drag the app into Applications
pictures.line: Right from the window of the disk image.

pictures.caption: 3 · Open the app and allow it the same way
pictures.line: “Done”, then “Open Anyway” once more, and never again.

pictures.caption: 4 · Click “Open System Settings”
pictures.line: The app asks for Full Disk Access.

pictures.caption: 4 · Turn Storage Manager on
pictures.line: Then click “Restart App” in the app.
